capabilities: chat with DeepSeek about concepts with streaming replies
generate and save concept notes from conversations
suggest links between new concept notes and existing notes
compress long conversation context with inspectable summaries
update previously saved concept notes with paragraph revisions
extras: Chat interface and commands use Chinese labels. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4+. Requests go directly to DeepSeek (no proxy or analytics); DeepSeek handles submitted content under its own terms. Android WebView streaming and real-device sync are still awaiting actual-use validation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with an AI about concepts and save those conversations as structured, linked notes in the vault.

relations.evidence: Discuss concepts with DeepSeek in Obsidian and turn a conversation into an editable Markdown concept note.

requires.name: DeepSeek API usage may require payment

summary: DeepSeek chat plugin that turns concept discussions into editable Markdown notes linked to existing vault notes, with context compression and revision tracking.
